personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK (Modified with Modern Geometric Sans for AR Tech feel)
personality_one_liner: A dark, cinematic, and premium AR visualization tool where the room photography is the hero and the cyan tech-accent guides the measurement and design process.

spacing.rule: Use 8pt grid system. Generous padding around content. Empty halves of the screen equal broken layout. Sticky primary CTAs at bottom.

do's: Use on bottom tab bar to allow room imagery to bleed through.
Use on bottom sheet handles/headers during curtain selection.
Use heavily on the AR measurement camera overlay pills (e.g., dimensions).
dont's: Never blur body text regions or form inputs.
Do not overdo glass on dense text screens like settings.

screens.name: Ana Sayfa (Home)
screens.purpose: Welcome the user, offer primary entry points (Capture/Upload), and display sample projects.

states.empty: No saved projects yet - 'İlk projeni oluştur' CTA.
states.error: Failed to load projects - Retry button.

screens.layout: Large Display title: 'Perdeni seç, odana mükemmel uyum'. Below it, a 2-column grid of two primary hero cards: 'Fotoğraf Çek' (Camera icon) and 'Fotoğraf Yükle' (Gallery icon) using surfaceSecondary with a subtle brandTertiary gradient. Below, a horizontal scroll section 'Örnek Projeler' showcasing premium dark interior photos. Bottom tab navigation: Ana Sayfa, Perdeler, Projeler, Ayarlar.

screens.name: Ölçüm (Camera AR Measurement)
screens.purpose: Full-screen camera view to auto-detect or manually place window/wall measurements.
screens.layout: Full-bleed camera feed. Minimal translucent UI. Top-left: Close icon. Center: Subtle targeting crosshair. Floating measurement pills (e.g., '340cm x 260cm') in heavy frosted glass overlay with white text and cyan borders. Bottom-center: Large round primary capture button with cyan accent. Bottom-left: Undo arrow.

screens.name: Perde Seçimi (Curtain Selection)
screens.purpose: Visualize the room with different curtains, textures, and types.

states.loading: Applying AI render (shimmer effect on image).

screens.layout: Top 60% is the room image (hero). Bottom 40% is a Bottom Sheet (glassmorphism enabled). Inside sheet: Horizontal scrolling filter chips (Tümü, Fon Perde, Tül Perde, Stor, Zebra). Selected chip uses brandPrimary. Below chips: 2-column or 3-column grid of circular or squircle curtain thumbnails with labels (Keten Dokulu, Gri Pileli, vs.). Sticky bottom CTA: 'Uygula' or 'Projeyi Kaydet'.

screens.name: Proje Detayı (Project Detail)
screens.purpose: Review saved AR curtain render and dimensions.
screens.layout: Hero image of the final rendered room with top-to-bottom gradient scrim. Large Title of project name. Metadata rows (Dimensions, Curtain Type, Fabric) in surfaceSecondary cards. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom: 'Siparişe Geç' or 'Paylaş'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the specific Turkish vocabulary requested by the user: Ana Sayfa, Perdeler, Projeler, Ayarlar for Tabs; Tümü, Fon Perde, Tül Perde, Stor, Zebra for filter chips.
Implement the 'Dark Glass / Luxe' aesthetic but with a modern, high-tech touch suitable for AR (use the requested Cyan #00D4E4 for primary actions and active states).
For the 'Perde Seçimi' (Curtain Selection) screen, ensure the bottom sheet containing textures uses expo-blur over the background image so it feels cinematic.

The camera measurement screen must maintain a full-bleed camera feed with minimalistic UI. Use high-contrast frosted glass pills for measurement dimensions (e.g., '340cm x 260cm') to ensure readability over any room background.
Render images for curtain textures in circular or squircle thumbnails (radius: md or lg).
Always apply a vertical gradient scrim under text when text sits on top of images (e.g., in the project details screen).
